description: This is a source file for a custom Log4j filter class named OFBizDynamicThresholdFilter. It is designed to dynamically adjust logging thresholds based on contextual data, specifically tailored for the Apache OFBiz framework. The filter overrides log event filtering behavior to check for specific context key-value pairs and determine whether to accept or reject log events based on custom logic involving log levels and context.

classes.name: OFBizDynamicThresholdFilter
classes.description: A custom Log4j filter that dynamically adjusts logging levels based on context key-value pairs, used within the Apache OFBiz framework to enable more granular and context-aware logging control.

methods.name: createFilter
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance of OFBizDynamicThresholdFilter based on provided parameters, including the key to check, pairs of value-level mappings, and actions for match/mismatch conditions.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Core method that determines whether a log event passes the filter based on the event's level and contextual data.

methods.name: currentContextData
methods.description: Retrieves the current thread's context data for use in filtering decisions.

methods.name: getKey
methods.description: Returns the key used for context data comparison.

methods.name: getLevelMap
methods.description: Returns the map of context value strings to log4j Level objects.
